[{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api/issues/comments/5442390007","html_url":"https://github.com/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api/issues/612#issuecomment-5442390007","issue_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api/issues/612","id":5442390007,"node_id":"IC_kwDOB8VGQc8AAAABRGRH9w","user":{"login":"fetchworks-dev","id":321837933,"node_id":"U_kgDOEy7bbQ","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/321837933?v=4","gravatar_id":"","url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev","html_url":"https://github.com/fetchworks-dev","followers_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev/followers","following_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev/following{/other_user}","gists_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/fetchworks-dev/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"created_at":"2026-08-27T16:52:18Z","updated_at":"2026-08-27T16:52:18Z","body":"nice catch, this is real. urllib3 leaves POST out of `DEFAULT_ALLOWED_METHODS` on purpose (retrying a non-idempotent method can double-submit), but the innertube player call is effectively read-only so adding POST to `allowed_methods` is safe and correct here. right now a 429 on that POST falls straight through to `IpBlocked` while only the `/watch` and `/api/timedtext` GETs get the retry+rotate benefit, exactly as you traced.

one thing worth adding for anyone who hits this: the retry only rescues you if the pool behind it is residential. `WebshareProxyConfig` is, so the fix lands for that path. but a lot of folks wire in generic/datacenter proxies, and DC egress usually doesn't even get a 429 on the player endpoint, it gets a 200 with no captionTracks (a bot-check page), which this lib maps to `TranscriptsDisabled`, not `IpBlocked`. so more retries against the same DC subnet won't recover it. from my own probing it's roughly 9 in 10 videos blocked from datacenter vs clean from residential. necessary fix, just not sufficient when the exits aren't residential.

disclosure, I maintain a hosted extractor in this space so I stare at the egress behavior a lot. kept this technical since it's a lib bug and not a help thread.","author_association":"NONE","pin":null,"reactions":{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api/issues/comments/5442390007/reactions","total_count":0,"+1":0,"-1":0,"laugh":0,"hooray":0,"confused":0,"heart":0,"rocket":0,"eyes":0},"performed_via_github_app":null,"minimized":null}]
